source.authority: working-tree candidate; no RCL Core promotion, production-provider admission, main-branch mutation or release claim

canonicalSeam.studio: Reality Studio authors one explicit cue_id -> asset_id -> file_role -> asset_sha256 binding and seals the audio target profile.
canonicalSeam.behaviorAndRsr: Behavior and RSR continue to own cue identity, authoritative tick and spatial parameters; neither infers a file asset.
canonicalSeam.assetManifest: Reality Build reuses the existing content-addressed asset/file records and exposes audio_files without promoting audio to primary_visual.
canonicalSeam.targetProvider: Reality Build compiles the profile into a deterministic target plan and the local Web Audio buffer Provider performs the target request/decode/schedule candidate.
canonicalSeam.rclBoundary: The package is an auxiliary target-lowering provider seam, not an RCL Core promotion.

localChromium.execution: Playwright-driven local Chromium headless run against the freshly built web-release
localChromium.claimBoundary: Chromium executed the exact content-addressed WAV request and moved the candidate receipt from decode-pending to scheduled; this is not audible playback or spatialization proof.

commands: local Chromium candidate execution through Playwright
verification.expectedResult: All listed local checks pass; no hosted CI, Android audio, physical-device or human-listening result is inferred.

stressCase: An authored audio cue must survive explicit Studio binding, content-addressed asset resolution, target plan sealing, browser request/decode scheduling and receipt generation without inventing an asset or mutating Behavior/RSR authority.
donorAdvantage: Studio asset records already carry real sfx-wav roles and hashes; Behavior/RSR already carry deterministic cue/tick/spatial semantics; the candidate reuses those seams rather than adding a second audio asset registry or timeline evaluator.
regressionCase: Projects without an audio target profile retain the explicitly labeled legacy procedural fallback; primary_visual remains visual-only; missing roles, wrong hashes and invalid profiles remain blocked instead of selecting another file.
boundaries: Only the explicit footstep-ice binding is demonstrated; no cue-name, first-file or Sequence-track inference is claimed.
The browser receipt proves file request, Web Audio decode scheduling and target identity, not audible output, gain quality or latency.
spatial_parameters_forwarded is false: RSR spatial-audio parameters are not claimed as 3D spatialized audio by this candidate.
No Android WebView audio, native audio backend, physical device, streaming, mixing, production mastering, performance curve or human listening acceptance is claimed.
No K400 gate is promoted to PASS.
nextCandidate: Use the same sealed plan in the generated Android/WebView host, capture request/decode receipts there, then separately decide and test how RSR spatial parameters are admitted to a real spatial audio Provider; keep physical-device and human listening gates open.
